loop: Docs/ElementalLoop/PLAYBOOK.md: these steps are steps 3-5 of Garrett's elemental vessel loop (2026-11-12, top priority)
note: The machine-readable steps of AI_PLAN.md. Tools/Compute reads it: a job whose plan is in ai_plans must serve a step (its plan_step, or a step whose jobs match its plan and stage); a job of a plan in other_plans is not AI work; any other job is off the plan and no worker runs it (compute.py validate and self-test fail on it). Edit the doc and this file together.

other_plans.bioforms: swarm bodies and NCA creatures: the bestiary, not vessel AI (Garrett, /bioform-forge)

retired_jobs.drive-rhino-regatta: trains a drive IN Regatta; the plan trains each vessel in its own Time game and races Regatta against those fixed AIs (AI_PLAN.md rule 4)
retired_jobs.drive-manta-regatta: trains a drive IN Regatta; the plan trains each vessel in its own Time game and races Regatta against those fixed AIs (AI_PLAN.md rule 4)
retired_jobs.drive-dolphin-regatta: trains a drive IN Regatta; the plan trains each vessel in its own Time game and races Regatta against those fixed AIs (AI_PLAN.md rule 4)
retired_jobs.skimrace-squirrel-i3: one intensity only; replaced by skimrace-squirrel-time, one genome scored on I1-I4 (AI_PLAN.md rule 2)
retired_jobs.skimrace-squirrel-i4: one intensity only; replaced by skimrace-squirrel-time, one genome scored on I1-I4 (AI_PLAN.md rule 2)
retired_jobs.drive-manta-redline: raced Regatta's point-mass model (full throttle, Regatta's steering, no nose lag), about 3x faster than the editor's AI Mantas, on the mean of ln seconds; replaced by redline-manta-time, the Redline simulator and the composite (AI_PLAN.md rule 2; 2026-11-03)

steps.title: Each vessel's universal Time AI: one genome per vessel, trained on its own Time arcade game(s), scored on all four intensities at once, grown from every genome that exists
Regatta's course features, searched against the FIXED universal Time AIs of every vessel: a pool of courses whose spreads cancel, shuffled in one Regatta level (Garrett, 2026-11-06)
The smallest elemental tuning that closes what the course leaves: each vessel's Time baseline
Each vessel's universal Charge AI, trained on its Charge arcade game, mirror matches scored on petals taken (SILENCE.md section 6)
Broadside balanced against the fixed universal Charge AIs until every vessel's petal plateau is the same
Each vessel's universal Mass AI, trained on its Mass arcade game
Each vessel's universal Space AI, trained on its Space arcade game

Brood Rush, Mass and Space together, balanced against the fixed universal Mass and Space AIs on each vessel's net control of space; each vessel's cultivator/destroyer position is measured, never set (Garrett, 2026-11-12, Docs/ElementalLoop/PLAYBOOK.md)
The pilot's callsign biases what an element's AI goes after (OPAL: omni crystals, deny them; BANDIT: opposing vessels, joust them), learned per callsign on top of the element genomes
A squad seat's AI is chosen by its cards: vessel x element picks the genome, the pilot biases it (the artifact later); voyages fly it
